backendProfiles.label: Dev · SQLite · in-process
backendProfiles.notes: Default Gemini dogfood. Isolated DB at dogfood/.run/dogfood.db. Best for multi-framework + FinOps + HITL checkpoint demos.

backendProfiles.label: Prod-like · Postgres · Redis
backendProfiles.notes: Matches CI matrix cell postgres_redis. Stop dogfood first if it owns :2026.

backendProfiles.label: SQL · Postgres · in-process
backendProfiles.notes: Single-instance Postgres without Redis queue. Good for governance + FinOps without multi-CP infra.

backendProfiles.label: NoSQL · Mongo · Redis
backendProfiles.notes: Governance Admin routes return 501. Confirm UI empty states and run/ thread APIs still work.

backendProfiles.label: Docker dev · SQLite
backendProfiles.notes: Zero-deps compose profile. echo_agent only — no Gemini dogfood runners.

backendProfiles.label: Prod-like · 3× CP · Postgres · Redis
backendProfiles.notes: Requires RUNNER_TOKEN in .env. Leaves stack up for Admin inspection. Not a Gemini stack.

conversationScenarios.title: Thread history recall
turns: What is the capital of France?
What language do they speak there?
Name one famous landmark in that city.
List every question I asked you in this conversation, in order, quoting my exact wording.
conversationScenarios.pass: Final reply lists all three prior user questions in order. Check Admin → Threads → your thread for persisted messages.

conversationScenarios.title: Follow-up context
turns: My favorite color is teal. Remember that.
conversationScenarios.pass: Second reply mentions teal without you repeating it.

conversationScenarios.title: HITL approve path
turns: Send the weekly report email to alice@example.com
conversationScenarios.pass: Run interrupts; click Approve; final message confirms email sent. Deny path: new thread, same prompt, click Deny → cancelled message.

conversationScenarios.title: Usage metering
turns: Reply with exactly one word: kite.
conversationScenarios.pass: Right panel shows usage JSON. Admin → Spend shows token counts > 0 for tenant default.

features.title: Start Gemini dogfood stack
steps: Copy .env.llm.example → .env.llm and set GOOGLE_API_KEY.
./examples/gemini/dogfood/start.sh — wait for healthy control plane.

features.title: Run one prompt on every framework UI
steps: 3101 LangGraph — ask anything; confirm AI reply + usage in side panel.
3102 LangChain — same.
3103 CrewAI — same (skip if venv missing; start.sh logs it).
3104 LlamaIndex — same.
3106 AutoGen — same.
3107 LangGraph.js — same (skip if node_modules missing).
./examples/gemini/dogfood/smoke_usage.sh — all agents emit Output.usage.

features.title: Overview + navigation
steps: Admin → Overview: agent/thread/run counts reflect your dogfood runs.
Click through every nav item once — no blank crash pages.

features.title: Agents + Try agent
steps: Admin → Agents: gemini_* agents listed with tenant default.
Open an agent detail — schema + version history load.
Admin → Try: pick gemini_langgraph, send a prompt, watch live SSE + usage.
Raw protocol panel shows lifecycle/values/end events.

features.title: Runs + run manifest
steps: Admin → Runs: dogfood runs appear with success/interrupted statuses.
Open a completed run — SSE event log replays.
Run manifest card shows agent, tenant, policy labels; cache-hit runs show badge if you trigger llm_cache.

features.title: Threads
steps: Admin → Threads: threads from dogfood UIs listed.
Open a multi-turn thread — run list matches your conversation.

features.title: Spend dashboard + export
steps: Admin → Spend: Est. USD and token totals > 0 after Gemini runs.
Filter by tenant default / agent gemini_langgraph — numbers narrow correctly.
Download CSV and JSON — files open and contain your runs.

features.title: Soft budget alert
steps: Admin → Spend → Live FinOps config: set tenant default max_usd_per_day to 0.0001, soft=true.
Send several Gemini prompts from dogfood until ~50% of cap (soft_pct=50 in dogfood config).
Spend → Alerts table shows budget_soft or budget_alert row.
Restore budget to a sane value (e.g. 5) when done.

features.title: Unpriced model path (optional)
steps: Admin → Try → run unknown_provider_agent if registered, OR temporarily remove a model from pricebook overlay.
Confirm usage_unpriced alert appears on Spend when tokens exist but USD is $0.

features.title: Graph interrupt approve / deny
steps: http://127.0.0.1:3105/ — send any message.
Approve → 'Email sent to alice@example.com successfully!'
New thread, same prompt, Deny → 'Action was not approved. Cancelled.'
Admin → Runs: interrupted run visible; resumed run completes.

features.title: Automated governance bar (SQL)
steps: make smoke-governance — PASS (Postgres test infra).
Optional manual: Admin → Grants create a deny rule; Admin → Audit shows decision.

features.title: Connector pending queue (if connectors configured)
steps: Requires connector + mandatory HITL setup on SQL backend — see docs/grants in site/support.
Admin → Pending: approve and deny buttons work; Audit records outcome.
Skip on Mongo profile — expect 501 empty state.

features.title: Kill switch + break-glass
steps: Admin → Kill: pause an agent; Try agent run should fail or stall per policy.
Clear kill switch — runs work again.
Admin → Break-glass: mint ≤24h window with reason; revoke when done.

features.title: Registry, cron, webhooks pages
steps: Admin → Registry: list loads (may be empty in dogfood).
Admin → Cron: schedules visible if configured in langgraph.json.
Admin → Webhooks: dead-letter list loads; redeliver button present on rows (unsigned resend — expected limitation).

features.title: Spot-check non-SQLite profiles
steps: Stop dogfood if testing another profile on :2026.
Run postgres_redis profile — /readyz 200, create echo run via Try or curl.
Run mongo_redis profile — governance pages show SQL-required message; runs still work.
make test-matrix (optional overnight) — full framework × backend golden diff.

features.title: External LLM history audit
steps: Complete the 'Thread history recall' scenario on port 3101.
Copy the question log from the UI sidebar.
In a separate Gemini chat, paste: 'Here are the questions I asked my agent: … — did I miss any?'
Compare — your manual log should match the agent's final list reply.

features.title: Leave to automation
steps: make test — unit + protocol fixtures.
make smoke-governance — policy phases 0–3.
make smoke-multi — 3× CP soak entry.
make test-matrix — framework × backend goldens.
EKS smoke / paid soak — docs/k8s-eks-soak.md.
